name: Aivora HC Maturity Framework
description: A six-dimension maturity model for diagnosing the strategic, structural, and cultural health of an organization's human capital function.

tiers.label: Reactive
tiers.summary: Foundational gaps. HC operates transactionally. Decisions are ad-hoc, data is sparse, and outcomes are inconsistent.

tiers.label: Structured
tiers.summary: Basic processes exist. Some standardization in place but execution is inconsistent across business units.

tiers.label: Integrated
tiers.summary: HC is aligned with business strategy. Practices are evidence-informed and outcomes are measured.

tiers.label: Strategic
tiers.summary: HC drives competitive advantage. Predictive analytics, continuous adaptation, and clear ROI on talent decisions.

dimensions.name: Strategy & Capability
dimensions.summary: How clearly HC priorities are tied to business strategy and translated into capability needs.

tierDescriptors.reactive: HC priorities set in isolation. No formal capability planning.
tierDescriptors.structured: Annual HC plan exists but is loosely linked to business priorities.
tierDescriptors.integrated: HC priorities derive from strategic capability gaps. Reviewed quarterly.
tierDescriptors.strategic: Continuous capability foresight. HC priorities adjust to scenario-based business shifts.

dimensions.name: Talent Architecture
dimensions.summary: Role design, job architecture, career frameworks, and succession discipline.

tierDescriptors.reactive: Roles defined by individual managers. No job architecture.
tierDescriptors.structured: Job families exist. Career paths inconsistently documented.
tierDescriptors.integrated: Unified job architecture. Career paths and succession plans for critical roles.
tierDescriptors.strategic: Skills-based architecture with dynamic talent pools and internal mobility marketplace.

dimensions.name: Engagement & Culture
dimensions.summary: Employee experience, culture coherence, and engagement signal management.

tierDescriptors.reactive: Annual engagement survey at best. No systematic action.
tierDescriptors.structured: Engagement measured regularly. Limited action planning.
tierDescriptors.integrated: Continuous listening. Manager-level action plans with accountability.
tierDescriptors.strategic: Engagement data drives strategic decisions. Culture is a measurable asset.

dimensions.name: Leadership & HiPo
dimensions.summary: Leadership pipeline strength, HiPo identification rigor, and development depth.

tierDescriptors.reactive: Leaders identified by reputation. No formal HiPo process.
tierDescriptors.structured: Annual talent review. HiPo defined inconsistently across business units.
tierDescriptors.integrated: Calibrated HiPo identification. Development plans tracked.
tierDescriptors.strategic: Predictive leadership analytics. Multi-horizon succession depth for every critical role.

dimensions.name: Workforce Analytics
dimensions.summary: Data quality, reporting maturity, and use of evidence in HC decisions.

tierDescriptors.reactive: Headcount reports only. Data lives in spreadsheets.
tierDescriptors.structured: Standard HR dashboards. Limited business integration.
tierDescriptors.integrated: Integrated workforce metrics. Used in business reviews.
tierDescriptors.strategic: Predictive models inform hiring, retention, and capability investment.

dimensions.name: Change Readiness
dimensions.summary: Capacity to absorb and lead change - governance, comms, and behavior shift.

tierDescriptors.reactive: Change happens to the org. Resistance is the norm.
tierDescriptors.structured: Change methodology exists but applied inconsistently.
tierDescriptors.integrated: Change capability embedded in PMO. Adoption tracked.
tierDescriptors.strategic: Change is a core competency. Behavioral data informs intervention design.
